headline: BDT 1.76 crore worth of gold found around man's waist
summary: Authorities recovered gold bars valued at 17.6 million taka hidden on a man's person.
details: Authorities have seized gold worth BDT 1.76 crore from a young man.

Officials are further investigating the source of the gold and the identity of the individual involved.

headline: Mithamain BNP president attacked and injured in Kishoreganj
summary: The Upazila BNP president was reportedly hacked with sharp weapons, following a previous incident where he allegedly bit a businessman's ear.
details: The President of the Mithamain Upazila BNP has been hacked and seriously injured in an attack.
The victim is currently receiving medical treatment for his injuries.
The attack follows a previous and unusual incident involving the same BNP leader, who was accused of biting a businessman's ear.
A legal case has already been filed against the BNP leader regarding the ear-biting incident.
Local authorities are investigating the circumstances surrounding the attack on the party president.
